title: Find the bug
summary: Three scripts that look right and train nothing. Find out why with the tools in the Studio.

steps.title: Every trip ends at once
steps.body:
This script compiles, but a run trained with it learns nothing. Press Check: the test drive ends almost as soon as it starts.

Every SUV starts standing still, so a stop rule for being slow ends every trip on its first tick. Use `car.noProgress` instead. It only counts time spent still without a good reason, like a red light or a person crossing.

check.message: The test drive should last more than 10 seconds.

hints: The Test run tab shows which rule stopped the drive.
Replace the slow rule with stop "stuck" when car.noProgress > 8 s.

steps.title: A rule that never fires
steps.body:
The Problems tab has a warning for this one. The SUV tops out at 20 m/s, so a cost for going over 30 m/s never applies and brains never hear about speeding.

`rules.speeding` is true while the SUV is over the speed limit where it is, which is what the line meant to say.

check.message: The script should compile without warnings.

hints: Hover the underlined condition to read the warning.

steps.title: One reward drowns the rest
steps.body:
Another warning. The arrival prize is so much bigger than every other reward that the others barely count: brains learn to chase the prize and nothing about getting there.

Keep the biggest reward within about a hundred times the next biggest. Bring the prize back to 10.

check.message: The script should compile without warnings.

hints: The Problems tab points at the line with the prize.
